summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing open-market B-share repurchases under an ongoing buyback program of up to DKK 15 billion for the 12 months from February 4, 2026. The filing reports weekly transactions from July 27 to August 3, 2026, totaling 1,145,000 B shares at average prices from DKK 305.61 to 335.98, bringing cumulative program repurchases to 27,064,179 shares for DKK 7,533,256,457. Treasury holdings reached 44,249,480 B shares, or 1.0% of share capital. The program complies with EU Safe Harbour rules; details are published on novonordisk.com.
